sources.stream: USGS gazetteer phrase or the waterfall name when it names the creek or river. Confirmed by USGS NLDI mainstem navigation, not by borrowing a nearby gauge.
sources.network: USGS NLDI mainstem UM and DM, 12 km
sources.temperature: USGS NWIS parameter 00010: instantaneous values newer than 48 hours, otherwise a daily mean from the last 120 days, plus monthly means of approved daily values for months with at least 3 years
sources.samples: Water Quality Portal results from the last 10 years (USGS, EPA, and state agencies)
sources.assessment: EPA ATTAINS assessment lines within 1 km of the falls, name-matched to the stream, linked to How's My Waterway
sources.notUsed: Coastal beach and state swim-advisory feeds. They do not identify the named inland stream at a waterfall.
